concerns.text: The plan uses a paired t‑test on per‑document log‑perplexities (see ‘perform a **paired t‑test** on per‑document perplexities (FR‑003‑FR‑008)’). A paired t‑test assumes the differences are approximately normally distributed. The plan does not include any check (e.g., Shapiro‑Wilk test or visual inspection) to verify this assumption, nor does it specify a fallback non‑parametric test (e.g., Wilcoxon signed‑rank) if normality is violated. This methodological omission could invalidate the claimed statistical significance (SC‑003).
